questions.question_text: Prove that (cosec θ - cot θ)^2 = (1 - cos θ) / (1 + cos θ).
questions.marking_scheme_answer: LHS = (1 - cos θ)^2 / sin^2 θ = (1 - cos θ)^2 / (1 - cos^2 θ) = (1 - cos θ)/(1 + cos θ) = RHS.
